{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species, dropping rows with missing flipper_length_mm
df_clean = df.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
mean_flipper_by_species = df_clean.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Sort by mean flipper length in descending order
mean_flipper_by_species_sorted = mean_flipper_by_species.sort_values(ascending=False)

# Get the species with the highest mean flipper length
highest_mean_species = mean_flipper_by_species_sorted.index[0]

# Print the full table for evidence
mean_flipper_by_species_sorted"}
